crossRefs.keyword: was before the temple on the east, measured 100 cubits

translations.web: For the length of the rooms that were in the outer court was fifty cubits. Behold, before the temple were one hundred cubits.
translations.bsb: For the chambers on the outer court were fifty cubits long, while those facing the temple were a hundred cubits long.
translations.kjv: For the length of the chambers that were in the utter court was fifty cubits: and, lo, before the temple were an hundred cubits.
translations.asv: For the length of the chambers that were in the outer court was fifty cubits: and, lo, before the temple were a hundred cubits.
